metadata.source: Georgia Secretary of State absentee ballot file and active voter registration table

warnings: 2022: 2 counties are short in the absentee file (Fulton (133,278 in the file vs 305,815 official), Gwinnett (119,446 in the file vs 192,162 official)); the comparison is cut at 2022-10-22, the last complete day, and the repeat-voter figure is omitted
